reviews.author: Kelsey Crowley
reviews.text: Absolutely incredible!!! This is the second sound bath I've experienced and the ambiance plus care pre, during, and post was 10/10! Stunning layout and musician. Greeted with a lavender seed eye mask, heated Navajo blanket, and beautiful Navajo beaded bracelets. The company followed up with gorgeous photos and video. They even included the digital soundtracks for the music created by the artist. I highly recommend to anyone considering!

reviews.author: KJS
reviews.text: Amazing experience! Such a great way to relax, unwind, and recharge after a long week. From the calm water and harmonic sounds to the light breeze, it was the perfect float and sound bath experience. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Nicole Fournier
reviews.text: What a beautiful way to spend an evening of calmness and relaxation. I give it two thumbs up and would love to do it again.

reviews.author: Pam Marshall
reviews.text: PebbleCreek hosted a Floating Soundbath experience with Desert Paddleboards — Tibetan bowls, lavender eye mask, chimes and live flute music. A very cool and relaxing experience.

reviews.author: Tammy Gallup
reviews.text: I loved this relaxing paddle board sound bath experience. I usually do sound baths at a yoga studio with a hard floor and yoga mat. Although the paddleboard is firm, the water makes it give a little, so with the extra towels rolled under my knees it was more comfortable than what I'm used to. I found being outdoors looking up at the sky especially peaceful and calming. Overall great experience!!
